sources.title: McDonald's Canada Nutrition Calculator (values loaded by the official calculator page)
sources.publishedNote: Not stated by the calculator; values as shown on 2026-10-25 (country CA, language en)

builds.calculator: McDonald's Canada's item as listed in its nutrition calculator, using the values it displays (already rounded by McDonald's). Customizations and other sizes cannot be calculated here.
builds.drink: As listed in the calculator for that size and volume. A weight in grams is not stated.

sources.title: Tim Hortons Canada Nutrition Information (PDF linked from timhortons.ca/nutrition-and-allergens)
sources.publishedNote: "This document reflects information for our products as of July 2026"; file Last-Modified 10 Jul 2026

builds.standard: Standard product formulation as listed by Tim Hortons Canada; values may vary with suppliers and assembly (as the document states). Changes to bread, cheese, sauce or meat are not calculated.
builds.coffee: Original Blend brewed coffee as listed, black: no cream, milk or sugar.
builds.doubledouble: Double Double as listed by Tim Hortons: its stated values include the standard cream and sugar. Other amounts are not calculated.
builds.espresso: Standard recipe as listed, with its default milk. Other milks, syrups or extra shots are not calculated.
builds.drink: As listed. Tim Hortons names the size; the cup volume is not stated.
builds.baked: As listed; the document notes that baked goods may vary in size.

sources.title: Subway Canada Nutrition Information (Nutrition Data Tables, CAN_Nutrition_ENG_9-16-26.pdf)

builds.sub6: Subway's standard 6-inch recipe as listed. The table does not say which bread, cheese, vegetables or sauce that standard build uses, so changes to them cannot be calculated.
builds.footlong: Footlong values are the 6-inch values doubled, as the table instructs ("one footlong = two 6" servings").
builds.wrap: Values include wrap, Processed Cheddar, mayonnaise, lettuce, tomato, onion and cucumber (as stated by Subway).
builds.salad: Values include lettuce, spinach, tomatoes, onions, green peppers, cucumbers and olives; dressing is not included (as stated by Subway).
builds.breakfast: Values include 6" Italian, scrambled egg patty and Canadian cheddar cheese (as stated by Subway).
builds.bowl: Subway's standard Power Bowl recipe as listed; its parts are not itemised.

sources.title: Pizza Pizza nutrition information (pizza, Walk-In slices)
sources.publishedNote: "Nutrition facts as of November 1st, 2023"; rows marked "Updated March 12, 2026" carry that date

sources.title: Pizza Pizza nutrition information (chicken wings and bites)
sources.publishedNote: "Nutrition facts as of November 1st, 2023" (nutrition index); no row dates

builds.small: One slice is 1/6 of a small 10-inch pizza (as stated by Pizza Pizza). No other size or cut is interchangeable with it. Saturated fat is left unknown: the page text loses its decimal point.
builds.walkin: One Walk-In slice, as listed ("Per Slice"). Pizza Pizza does not state the pizza's diameter for it.
builds.wings: Pizza Pizza lists the serving as "5" with no unit; it is shown exactly as listed.
